# Highlander Roofing & Construction

> Premium roofing and construction company serving Western North Carolina — Franklin, Sylva, Highlands, Cashiers, and surrounding mountain communities. GAF Master Elite certified, licensed General Contractor, 24-hour response.

Highlander is a family-operated roofing and construction firm built for the WNC mountain climate. Roofing is the primary authority (replacement, repair, metal, synthetic, storm damage, commercial). Construction is a focused secondary pillar (additions, outdoor living, flatwork). All work is performed by in-house crews dispatched from offices in Franklin and Sylva.
